source_documents.title: “Seeing” and Controlling Photoisomerization by (Z)‑/(E)‑Isomers with Aggregation-Induced Emission Characteristics

reference_evidence_units.quote: (Z)- and (E)-isomers without hydrogen-bonding exist in approximately 50/50 proportion in the photostationary state
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Adding 5 microliters TFA to 500 microliters of 5.3 mM chloroform solution gives approximately equal isomer proportions at photostationarity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: TFA disrupts self-complementary hydrogen bonding; this is not evidence of an ESIPT photocycle.

reference_evidence_units.quote: while that of its (E)- cousin is merely 28.3%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The E-to-Z conversion yield is 28.3% in chloroform with hydrogen bonding; the reverse Z-to-E value is 68.1%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Reaction yields, not fluorescence quantum yields. Main reports SI Table S1; SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: At the same time, the intramolecular motions are somewhat restricted to turn on the PL of the solution.
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors attribute PL turn-on of E-rich long supramolecular polymers to restricted internal motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The preceding text assigns linear polymer formation to E; cyclic dimers/small oligomers characterize Z under these conditions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: relative isomerization yields of (E)-TPE-UPy decrease at high solution concentrations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: E photoisomerization becomes less effective as concentration and polymerization increase.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main reports Figure S12; do not claim its raw data were inspected.

reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A B3LYP/6-31G** torsional scan gives a minimum S1-S0 gap of 0.16 eV for E near 90 degrees; the source assigns a CI-mediated nonradiative route.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 3 visually inspected. A finite-gap torsional scan is not an exact optimized degeneracy; no aggregate CI surface was computed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no photochemical reaction including photoisomerization occurs in a THF suspension of (E)-isomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A 5.3 mM THF suspension of E remains unchanged after 365 nm irradiation for 5 h according to the main text.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Main cites SI Figure S15; detection limit and raw NMR unavailable here. Limited solubility/precipitation differs from dissolved E.

reference_evidence_units.quote: bright blue emission is detected when aggregates of (E)-TPE-UPy are formed
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Formation of E polymer aggregates during irradiation of Z in THF accompanies bright blue fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A reacting mixture observation; not a numeric quantum-yield measurement of isolated E.

reference_evidence_units.quote: some (Z)-TPE-UPy molecules may coprecipitate with their (E)-cousins.
reference_evidence_units.subject: (E)-TPE-UPy
reference_evidence_units.conditions: UV 365 nm photoisomerization, typically 5.3 mM in chloroform or THF; comparisons with (Z)-TPE-UPy and acid-disrupted UPy hydrogen bonding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Concentrated THF reaction mixtures can coprecipitate Z; redissolution in chloroform and reprecipitation in THF purifies E.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Limits the blanket claim of 100% pure isolated E under every reaction condition.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source explicitly links longer E supramolecular polymers to restricted motion and PL turn-on.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Hydrogen-bonded polymerization and insoluble aggregates constrain E and inhibit the reverse isomerization.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source proposes a torsion-accessed CI; restricted photoisomerization is consistent with blocking that route. Finite-gap monomer scans and absent aggregate CI calculations limit this secondary assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source explicitly links longer E supramolecular polymers to restricted motion and PL turn-on.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Hydrogen-bonded polymerization and insoluble aggregates constrain E and inhibit the reverse isomerization.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: UPy self-complementary hydrogen-bonded polymerization is not demonstrated host-cavity/guest binding; acid disruption is a control.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Hydrogen bonding and acid addition do not establish excited-state proton transfer.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton or excimer mechanism is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No additional radiative-rate or state-balance explanation is isolated by the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No operative target-specific triplet or metal-mediated pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source proposes a torsion-accessed CI; restricted photoisomerization is consistent with blocking that route. Finite-gap monomer scans and absent aggregate CI calculations limit this secondary assignment.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
